title: AWS ALB (terraform-aws-modules/alb/aws)
description: Provision an Application/Network Load Balancer with target groups and listeners via ACK elbv2. Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/alb/aws module (core subset of its inputs).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the load balancer and its resources. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

name.title: name
name.description: The name of the LB. This name must be unique within your AWS account, can have a maximum of 32 characters, must contain only alphanumeric characters or hyphens, and must not begin or end with a hyphen.

name_prefix.title: name_prefix
name_prefix.description: Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with `name`.

load_balancer_type.title: load_balancer_type
load_balancer_type.description: The type of load balancer to create. Possible values are `application`, `gateway`, or `network`. The default value is `application`.

internal.title: internal
internal.description: If true, the LB will be internal. Defaults to `false`.

vpc_id.title: vpc_id
vpc_id.description: Identifier of the VPC where the target group(s) and security group will be created. An existing VPC ID — passed through to the ACK TargetGroup `vpcID` field.

subnets.title: subnets
subnets.description: A list of subnet IDs to attach to the LB. Subnets cannot be updated for Load Balancers of type `network`. Existing subnet IDs — passed through to the ACK LoadBalancer `subnets` field.

security_groups.title: security_groups
security_groups.description: A list of security group IDs to assign to the LB. Existing security group IDs — passed through to the ACK LoadBalancer `securityGroups` field.

ip_address_type.title: ip_address_type
ip_address_type.description: The type of IP addresses used by the subnets for your load balancer. The possible values are `ipv4` and `dualstack`.

enable_deletion_protection.title: enable_deletion_protection
enable_deletion_protection.description: If `true`, deletion of the load balancer will be disabled via the AWS API. This will prevent Terraform from deleting the load balancer. Defaults to `true`.

enable_http2.title: enable_http2
enable_http2.description: Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled in application load balancers. Defaults to `true`.

enable_cross_zone_load_balancing.title: enable_cross_zone_load_balancing
enable_cross_zone_load_balancing.description: If `true`, cross-zone load balancing of the load balancer will be enabled. For `network` and `gateway` type load balancers, this feature is disabled by default.

idle_timeout.title: idle_timeout
idle_timeout.description: The time in seconds that the connection is allowed to be idle. Only valid for Load Balancers of type `application`. Default: 60.

default_port.title: default_port
default_port.description: Default port used across the listener and target group.

default_protocol.title: default_protocol
default_protocol.description: Default protocol used across the listener and target group.

target_groups.title: target_groups
target_groups.description: Map of target group configurations to create. Each key is a logical target group name; the value mirrors the core fields of the terraform-aws-modules/alb/aws `target_groups` object (name, port, protocol, target_type, plus health check). Composed as ACK TargetGroup resources wired to the VPC via `vpcID`.

name.description: The name of the target group. If omitted, the stack name and target group key are used.

name_prefix.description: Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix.

port.description: The port on which the targets receive traffic.

protocol.description: The protocol to use for routing traffic to the targets (e.g. HTTP, HTTPS, TCP).

protocol_version.description: [HTTP/HTTPS protocol] The protocol version. One of GRPC, HTTP1 or HTTP2.

target_type.description: The type of target that you must specify when registering targets with this target group. One of instance, ip, lambda, or alb.

deregistration_delay.description: Amount of time for Elastic Load Balancing to wait before changing the state of a deregistering target from draining to unused, in seconds.

health_check.description: Health check configuration block for the target group.

enabled.description: Indicates whether health checks are enabled.

healthy_threshold.description: Number of consecutive health check successes required before considering a target healthy.

interval.description: Approximate amount of time, in seconds, between health checks of an individual target.

matcher.description: Response codes to use when checking for a healthy response from a target.

path.description: Destination for the health check request.

port.description: The port to use to connect with the target for health checks.

protocol.description: Protocol to use to connect with the target for health checks.

timeout.description: Amount of time, in seconds, during which no response means a failed health check.

unhealthy_threshold.description: Number of consecutive health check failures required before considering a target unhealthy.

tags.description: A map of tags to add to the target group.

listeners.title: listeners
listeners.description: Map of listener configurations to create. Each key is a logical listener name; the value mirrors the core fields of the terraform-aws-modules/alb/aws `listeners` object (port, protocol, certificate_arn, ssl_policy, and a default `forward` action). Composed as ACK Listener resources wired to the LoadBalancer via `loadBalancerRef` and to a TargetGroup via the forward action's `targetGroupRef`.

port.description: The port on which the load balancer is listening.

protocol.description: The protocol for connections from clients to the load balancer (e.g. HTTP, HTTPS, TCP).

certificate_arn.description: [HTTPS/TLS listeners] The ARN of an existing default ACM/IAM certificate for the listener. Passed through to the ACK Listener `certificates` field.

ssl_policy.description: [HTTPS/TLS listeners] The security policy that defines which protocols and ciphers are supported.

forward.description: Default forward action for the listener. References a target group declared in `target_groups`.

target_group_key.description: Key of the target group (from the `target_groups` map) to forward traffic to. Wired via the ACK Listener forward action `targetGroupRef`.

tags.description: A map of tags to add to the listener.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A map of tags to add to all resources.
